name: B10-0110/2026 (The Left) – Systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systemic oppression, inhumane conditions and arbitrary detentions by the regime in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran's authorities to stop using lethal force against peaceful protesters and to release everyone held for taking part in protests or for their political views. It condemns torture, inhumane prison conditions and the sharp rise in executions, and asks Iran to reveal what has happened to people who have disappeared. It also asks the European Union and its member states to give more money and technical help so Iranians can get secure internet access.

- The text asks Iran to stop lethal force, free detainees and reveal the fate of disappeared people.
- It calls for independent international investigation and more EU support for secure internet access in Iran.
- It is a statement of position only; it does not itself change any law.
